message.content: Add a dark mode to the todo app. It should follow the system setting by default, have a toggle in the header, and remember the choice. Keep the tests green.

content.text: I'll look at how styles are wired up first, then add theme tokens, a small hook, and a header toggle.

todos.content: Move colors into CSS variables with a dark set
Add a useTheme hook that persists to localStorage
Put a toggle in the header
